sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Retain the prior repairs: the ship-level sh:or now correctly contains the applicability alternatives, the false branch excludes polarClass, and hasInternalIceStrengthenedStructure remains universal without sh:minCount. Repair the unit IRI on qudt:unit: use http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MilliM (for example, @prefix unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> and sh:hasValue unit:MilliM), not qudt:MilliM expanded from http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/.
